title: Zephyrine and the Parish
author: J. M. Iversen
blurb: Marguerite Winterbourne, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
